purpose: Bounded, non-production inputs for instruction-design evaluation and later clean-context target trials.
authority: This manifest owns fixture paths, environment profiles, starting states, scripted failures, and expected observations. The suite owns evaluation requirements and scoring.

initial_configuration.assignment_algorithm: Sort groups by sha256(group_id + '|' + suite_id + '|' + suite_version), then assign whole groups round-robin to folds.
initial_configuration.rounding_rule: round-half-up requested case counts; preserve whole groups; require at least one case per holdout and development fold when coverage permits.
initial_configuration.insufficient_coverage_rule: Record exact achievable counts and insufficient_coverage; do not force a ratio or fold count onto an undersized suite.

development.training_rule: For each development fold, develop using all other fold groups and evaluate on that fold's unseen validation groups.

holdout.reason: All current fixture cases were visible during design and are exposed development evidence; no case may be relabeled as an untouched final holdout.

plans.coverage_reason: The visible fixture supports a reproducible five-fold development plan, but it cannot support an untouched final holdout.
